title: Check calls to various UNIX/Posix functions: open, pthread_once, calloc, malloc, realloc, alloca.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.API. It applies to C.

title: Check for calls to blocking functions inside a critical section.
summary: Blocking functions detected by this checker: sleep, getc, fgets, read, recv. Critical section handling functions modeled by this checker: lock, unlock, pthread_mutex_lock, pthread_mutex_trylock, pthread_mutex_unlock, mtx_lock, mtx_timedlock, mtx_trylock, mtx_unlock, lock_guard, unique_lock, scoped_lock. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.BlockInCriticalSection. It applies to C, C++.

title: Check improper use of chroot described by SEI Cert C recommendation POS05-C. Limit access to files by creating a jail.
summary: The checker finds usage patterns where chdir("/") is not called immediately after a call to chroot(path). clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.Chroot. It applies to C.

title: Check for improper use of errno.
summary: This checker implements partially CERT rule ERR30-C. Set errno to zero before calling a library function known to set errno, and check errno only after the function returns a value indicating failure. The checker can find the first read of errno after successful standard function calls. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.Errno. It applies to C.

title: Check for memory leaks, double free, and use-after-free problems.
summary: Traces memory managed by malloc()/free(). clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.Malloc. It applies to C.

title: Check for dubious malloc arguments involving sizeof.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.MallocSizeof. It applies to C.

title: Check for mismatched deallocators.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.MismatchedDeallocator. It applies to C, C++.

title: Check for calls of standard library functions that violate predefined argument constraints.
summary: For example, according to the C standard the behavior of function int isalnum(int ch) is undefined if the value of ch is not representable as unsigned char and is not equal to EOF. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.StdCLibraryFunctions. It applies to C.

title: Check C stream handling functions.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.Stream. It applies to C.

title: Check for proper usage of vfork.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.Vfork. It applies to C.

title: Check the size argument passed into C string functions for common erroneous patterns.
summary: Use -Wno-strncat-size compiler option to mute other strncat-related compiler warnings. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.cstring.BadSizeArg. It applies to C.

title: Check for arguments which are not null-terminated strings; applies to the strlen, strcpy, strcat, strcmp family of functions.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.cstring.NotNullTerminated. It applies to C.

title: Check for null pointers being passed as arguments to C string functions.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.cstring.NullArg. It applies to C.

title: Check for uninitialized reads from common memory copy/manipulation functions.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-unix.cstring.UninitializedRead. It applies to C.
